cluster_name.description: Name of the Grid Engine cluster; must be unique across all clusters in the network.

spool_dir.description: Root spool directory for the Grid Engine installation (master and exec spooling).

admin_user.description: User account with administrative privileges for Grid Engine.

default_shell.description: Default shell used when executing jobs (must exist on all execution hosts).

mail_opts.description: Email notification policy: 'a' = all, 'e' = error, 's' = suspend, 'n' = none.

priority_slots.description: Number of slots to use when computing dynamic job priority.

max_jobs_per_user.description: Maximum number of jobs a single user can submit simultaneously.

job_retention_time.description: Time (in seconds) after which job information is removed from the database.

qmaster_spool_dir.description: Spool directory specifically for the qmaster daemon.

qmaster_port.description: TCP port used by the qmaster daemon for client communication.

execd_port.description: TCP port used by execd daemons for communication with qmaster.

shadow_port.description: TCP port used by the shadow daemon (for job submission and control).

use_ssl.description: Enable SSL encryption for daemon-to-daemon and client-to-daemon communication.

log_dir.description: Directory where Grid Engine logs (qmaster, execd, scheduler) are written.

use_syslog.description: Whether to also forward logs to the system syslog daemon.

penv_list.description: List of parallel environments for multi-slot (MPI, OpenMP) jobs.

slots.description: Maximum number of slots per job in this PE.

require_hosts.description: Optional constraint: only allow jobs on hosts matching this pattern.

queue_list.description: List of queues (execution hosts groups) configured on this cluster.

hostlist.description: List of execution hosts assigned to this queue (by short hostname).

seq_no.description: Queue priority order (lower numbers have higher priority).

priority.description: Static priority (higher = more likely to run first).

slots.description: List of slot definitions per host, e.g., ['host1=4', 'host2=8'] or just numeric defaults.

start_job_prolog.description: Optional script to run before each job starts.

end_job_prolog.description: Optional script to run after each job ends.

hold.description: If true, queue is held (jobs cannot start).

submit_hosts.description: If set, restrict job submission to these hosts only.

exclude_hosts.description: Hosts explicitly excluded from this queue.

load_thresholds.description: Load thresholds at which jobs are suspended (e.g., 'cpu=1.5 load_avg=2.0').

suspend_thresholds.description: Load thresholds at which new jobs are suspended.

suspend_exit_delay.description: Seconds to wait before suspending a running job after threshold is exceeded.

resume_thresholds.description: Load thresholds that trigger resuming suspended jobs.

maxujobs.description: Maximum number of jobs per user in this queue (0 = no limit).

maxpjobs.description: Maximum number of jobs per project in this queue (0 = no limit).

maxmjobs.description: Maximum number of jobs per host in this queue (0 = no limit).

max_jslots.description: Maximum total job slots a user can consume across this queue.

min_jslots.description: Minimum job slots required per job in this queue.

job_factor.description: Multiplier applied to job priority (e.g., for premium queues).
